expectations.text: Explains Shepardizing/KeyCite purpose: confirm not overruled/reversed and find citing cases
Lists treatment codes such as criticized, distinguished, explained, followed, overruled, questioned, superseded
Explains binding vs persuasive authority by court hierarchy (higher court in same system binds; other states/circuits persuasive)
Distinguishes holding from dicta and/or majority vs concurring/dissenting opinions
Suggests free/low-cost path: read on Justia/FindLaw/Google Scholar and Shepardize at a law library with Lexis/Westlaw access
expectations.evidence: Law library free access, Google Scholar

expectations.text: Warns that online availability does not mean legal weight and/or headnotes are not law
expectations.evidence: No warning that online or headnotes lack legal weight
